description: Subdivision of the existing retail unit (Class E) into four retail units (Class E) with associated alterations to the shopfront.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Drawing PL/ASB/1, received 03/11/2026. Energy Statement, received 28/10/2026. Drawing PL/ASB/2, received 19/10/2026. Design & Access Statement and Fire Statement (both part superseded), received 20/08/2026.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be used for any of the following purposes within Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or within any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification:
�	E(b) Sale of food and drink for consumption (mostly) on the premises
�	E(d) Indoor sport, recreation or fitness (not involving motorised vehicles or firearms or use as a swimming pool or skating rink,)
�	E(f) Creche, day nursery or day centre (not including a residential use)
�	E(g)(iii) Industrial processes
Reason: The Council is satisfied that the use hereby permitted would not result in detriment to adjoining properties but would wish to control future changes of use within the same Use Class to protect nearby land uses and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed on the building(s) hereby permitted without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.
Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area and neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 6 - No deliveries or collections (including refuse and recyclable materials) shall be carried out at any of the approved commercial units except between the hours of 7:00am and 10:00pm from Monday to Saturday, and 9:00am and 1:00pm on Sundays, and all deliveries and servicing of the site shall be take place at the rear of the site, and not on the public highway. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 7 - Customers shall only be permitted at the four commercial units between the following hours:
08:00 - 23:00 Mondays to Saturdays;
09:00 - 22:00 Sundays and Public Holidays.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions, in particular those of the flats on the upper levels of the subject building.

Condition : 8 - No cables, wires, aerials, pipework (except any rainwater downpipes as may be shown on the approved drawings), meter boxes or flues shall be fixed to any elevation facing a highway. 
Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area and neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 9 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for no fewer than four bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed within the shared rear internal lobby. The approved facilities shall comprise a minimum of two Sheffield stands for four bikes and shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout. The facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 10 - No refuse and recycling bins, delivery cages, trolleys or any other items linked to deliveries and collection in association with the approved development are to be stored on the public highway
Reason: To protect the quality of the local environment and to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the public highway.
